vo.text: Look at this one tiny ridge, not the whole fingerprint.
vo.speak: Look at this one tiny ridge, not the whole fingerprint.

vo.text: Here, another ridge splits into two.
vo.speak: Here, another ridge splits into two.

vo.text: Details like these are called minutiae.
vo.speak: Details like these are called minutiae.

vo.text: A capacitive sensor maps them by measuring tiny electrical differences at many small points.
vo.speak: A capacitive sensor maps them by measuring tiny electrical differences at many small points.

vo.text: The phone records which details are present and where they sit relative to one another.
vo.speak: The phone records which details are present and where they sit relative to one another.

vo.text: That is a mathematical template, not a photograph.
vo.speak: That is a mathematical template, not a photograph.

vo.text: On your next touch, the phone builds another template.
vo.speak: On your next touch, the phone builds another template.

vo.text: It compares corresponding details, even if your finger shifted or rotated slightly.
vo.speak: It compares corresponding details, even if your finger shifted or rotated slightly.

vo.text: Enough matching features can unlock; too few cannot.
vo.speak: Enough matching features can unlock; too few cannot.

vo.text: Recognition means comparing patterns, not finding two identical pictures.
